verdict.rationale: GA4 publishes REST API references for the Data API and Admin API, and its docs offer a first-party Query Explorer for testing Data API queries interactively, which covers the core of running API calls live. The evidence does not show the reference pages themselves being interactive or carrying runnable examples per method. missing for 10: in-reference 'try it' execution or runnable per-method examples, coverage beyond the Data API (e.g. Admin API), independent or hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.
